title: Lumen Founders Grant 2027 — applications open (FICTIONAL DEMO DATA)
content:
# Lumen Founders Grant 2027

Fictional demo page for Opportunity Scout.

The Lumen Foundation awards **$50,000 non-dilutive grants** to early-stage startups applying AI to healthcare, agriculture or education in Africa.

## Eligibility
- Company registered and headquartered in an African country
- Pre-seed or seed stage, less than $1M raised
- At least one full-time technical founder
- Working prototype or pilot users

## Timeline
Applications close on **2027-02-15**. Finalists are announced in April 2027.

## Application questions
1. What problem are you solving and for whom? (max 150 words)
2. How does your product use AI, and why is AI necessary? (max 150 words)
3. What traction do you have so far?
4. How would you use the grant over 12 months?

No equity is taken. Apply at https://example.org/lumen-founders-grant/apply

# AgentForge Global Hackathon

A 48-hour virtual hackathon for teams building autonomous AI agents with LLM APIs, tool use and workflow automation. Open to developers worldwide, teams of 1-4.

- Prize pool: $25,000 cash plus $10,000 in API credits
- Registration deadline: 2027-01-08
- Event: 2027-01-10 to 2027-01-12, fully online
- Tracks: research agents, customer-support automation, developer tools

Judging criteria: technical depth, real-world usefulness, quality of evaluation.
